recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中有許多大型異常細胞，細胞質豐富、深藍並佈滿小空泡，核不規則、部分呈腎形或多核，與背景的小淋巴球及嗜中性球大小差異明顯，配合 CD30 陽性、ALK 陰性的免疫表型，符合 ALK 陰性退行性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）侵犯胸膜腔。
features: Numerous large, discohesive atypical cells several times the size of background lymphocytes
Moderate to low N:C ratio with irregular, reniform or multilobated nuclei, some binucleated
Finely granular chromatin with occasional visible nucleoli
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Loose aggregates of tumor cells without true epithelial cohesion or cell-in-cell molding
Background of small lymphocytes, neutrophils, eosinophil-like granulocytes and a single mesothelial cell
describe_en: Diff-Quik stained pleural fluid cytology shows a cellular specimen with numerous large atypical cells, occurring singly and in loose aggregates, against a background of small lymphocytes, granulocytes and occasional mesothelial cells. The atypical cells have irregular, reniform to multilobated nuclei, occasional binucleation, fine chromatin and small nucleoli, with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous small vacuoles. No true cohesive epithelial clusters are identified. In conjunction with the reported CD3+, CD4+, CD30+, ALK-negative immunophenotype, findings are consistent with involvement by ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with molding and are keratin-positive and CD30/CD4-negative, whereas these cells are discohesive lymphoid cells.
Mesothelial cells have dense cytoplasm with a peripheral clear 'lacy' skirt, central round nuclei and windows between cells, and are calretinin/WT1 positive.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / primary effusion lymphoma
ddx.vs: Large B-cell lymphomas lack T-cell antigens (PEL is also HHV-8 LANA positive), which requires immunophenotyping rather than morphology to exclude.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and monotonous with round nuclei and lipid vacuoles, lacking the large pleomorphic horseshoe-shaped nuclei seen here.
